set.body: From S5.4 review (s54-inventory-join). (1) InventorySourceVM/InventoryAnswer are not wired to any view; S5.6 should consume them and populate InventoryAnswer from admission responses; board parity for 'trials.csv · Inventory · 960 trials' / 'Absent · 6' is unverified in the UI. (2) DatasetRevisionSpec does not enforce that inventory identity roles agree with the fixation key (e.g. occurrence mapped in one file only); checkInventory only checks a trials source exists. (3) Re-map UX: remap() raises NeedsRemap only for missingForImport, so nothing tells the user an unmapped trials mapping is why Verify refuses; a project admitted by S5.2 with a trials.csv lacking a phase column can never resolve a mapping and there is no intent to drop a source from a re-import. (4) Command encodes "inventory":null while DatasetRevisionSpec omits it; make wire forms consistent. (5) FakeStudyBackend never serves Undeclared or InventoryRefused; add fake scenarios. (6) The InventoryMapping -> eyes4s TrialInventoryColumns translation exists only in InventoryJoinJvmSuite; S3.7 must own it in a shared JVM adapter.
set.title: S5.4 follow-ups: inventory UX, role agreement, wire consistency, fake coverage
